information_signals.author: PalakkadNews
information_signals.text:
📰 PalakkadNews - Today's Headlines Sunday, 1 November 2026
Palakkad More specialist doctors for Attappadi, new newborn care block planned After a rise in infant deaths, Health Minister K Muraleedharan said extra paediatricians, gynaecologists and anaesthetists will be posted at Kottathara Tribal Speciality Hospital. A new block with newborn care and an emergency operation theatre will be built. A paediatric ambulance and a mobile medical unit are also coming. Nenmara-Olipara road: PWD removes contractor for delay The Public Works Department has terminated the contractor who failed to finish the ₹16.50 crore road work despite several extensions. The order also says about ₹1.28 crore, 10% of the contract value, will be recovered from him as damages. Ottapalam-Cherpulassery road misses October 31 deadline too The promised October 31 completion date for the Ottapalam-Kizhoor stretch has passed with work still incomplete, two and a half years after it began. The Road Fund Board blames delays in Water Authority pipe laying. Commuters face dust on dry days and mud when it rains. Former SC development officer jailed, fined ₹10.25 lakh for fund fraud A Thrissur Vigilance Court has sentenced her for siphoning ₹8.96 lakh from housing, land and scholarship schemes by falsifying records in Palakkad block in 2002-03. Terms add up to 38 years' rigorous imprisonment, but will run concurrently. 65-year-old dies after being stabbed by teenage grandson near Alathur On October 19 he tried to stop his 16-year-old grandson from attacking the boy's 10-year-old sister with a knife and was stabbed. He died on Friday night at Thrissur Medical College Hospital. The girl has recovered. Police caught the boy and sent him to a juvenile home. Worker rescues 3-year-old from 20-ft-high shed roof At Alanallur, construction worker Shihabudheen (38) from Mannarkkad climbed up and brought down a migrant workers' daughter who had got onto the roof of a plastic sorting shed. It happened on Friday evening. The child is safe with her parents. Kerala Rain: yellow alert for Palakkad and 3 other districts on Monday A low-pressure system in the Bay of Bengal may bring isolated heavy rain across Kerala from November 1 to 4. On Monday (November 2), Idukki, Palakkad, Malappuram and Wayanad are under yellow alert. Thunderstorms and gusty winds are possible. Citizen Help Desks replace PRO system at police stations One desk will now take complaints and issue receipts, handle cyber fraud complaints, FIR copy requests and RTI applications. Women, senior citizens and persons with disabilities will get dedicated help. Sports State school sports meet: Palakkad second in athletics At the meet that ended in Kozhikode on Saturday, Palakkad finished second in athletics with 161.5 points, behind Malappuram. Thiruvananthapuram won the overall gold cup with over 2,000 points. ISL: Kerala Blasters hold Chennaiyin to goalless draw Saturday's match in Chennai ended 0-0. Chennaiyin missed a penalty when the shot hit the woodwork. Blasters keeper Amrinder Singh made key saves. One player from each side was sent off in stoppage time.
